items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Chip-based multi-select with command-palette dropdown, search, select-all and async loader. Compound and single-prop APIs.

items.name: number-range
items.title: Number Range
items.description: Two-thumb slider paired with synced number inputs. Min/max/step, currency or unit formatting, keyboard-first.

items.name: year-picker
items.title: Year Picker
items.description: Decade-grid year picker with keyboard nav, min/max bounds, single or range mode.

items.name: month-picker
items.title: Month Picker
items.description: 12-cell month grid with year stepper. Single or range mode.

items.name: time-picker
items.title: Time Picker
items.description: Hour, minute, second wheels with 12/24h modes and step intervals.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Chip input with paste-to-split, dedupe, validation hook, max tags. Compound and single-prop APIs.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable single-select with debounced async loader, group headings and clearable selection.

items.name: password-input
items.title: Password Input
items.description: Show/hide toggle with an optional pluggable strength meter. Compound and single-prop APIs.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone Input
items.description: Country dial-code dropdown with E.164 formatting.

items.name: currency-input
items.title: Currency Input
items.description: Locale-aware grouping, currency-symbol prefix, decimal precision control.

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: Drag-drop + click dropzone with previews, progress, accept and max-size validation.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: HSL / HEX / RGB tabs, eyedropper where supported, recent swatches.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Radix-powered accordion primitive used by the FAQ blocks. Plus icon rotates to an X on open.

items.name: hero-01
items.title: Hero · stat strip + install card
items.description: Split hero with eyebrow tag, display headline, dual CTA, three-stat strip and a mock install-card visual.

items.name: hero-02
items.title: Hero · centered editorial
items.description: Centered hero with animated live-pill, display headline with underlined accent, sub-copy and a trusted-by wordmark strip.

items.name: cta-01
items.title: CTA · framed band
items.description: Framed CTA card with forge corner marks, headline + sub-copy on the left, dual buttons stacked on the right.

items.name: cta-02
items.title: CTA · centered announce
items.description: Full-bleed centered CTA with framing rules, highlight underlay on the key word, and an inline install command.

items.name: faq-01
items.title: FAQ · sticky split
items.description: Two-column FAQ — sticky heading + contact card on the left, numbered accordion on the right.

items.name: faq-02
items.title: FAQ · centered grid
items.description: Centered heading with two-column accordion grid below. Each row tagged with a Qn index.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login · centered card
items.description: Centered login card with forge monogram, email + password (using the password-input component), remember-me, divider and GitHub / Google providers.

items.name: login-02
items.title: Login · split testimonial
items.description: Two-pane login: form on the left, dark testimonial panel with quote and metrics on the right. Uses the strength-meter variant of password-input.
